description: This file defines a React component named TimeRangePills, which renders a set of buttons representing different time ranges. Users can select a time range, and the component visually indicates the active selection. It utilizes utility functions and button components, and manages user interaction through props.

methods.name: TimeRangePills
methods.description: React functional component that displays a set of option buttons for selecting a time range. It highlights the active option and calls onChange handler when a button is clicked.
